from.slates: OddsPapi (15 games pulled, median of books)

how.A: Rebuild drive model (ratings, depth-chart QB, missing regulars, dome) + key-number score distribution (margin sd 13.4, total sd 13.5)
how.B: Sharp-weighted devigged market number; look-ahead lines (kickoff 4+ days out) trust about a third of a spread gap, later lines none; slate total guard. NFL game tiers max B (lean) until live tracking proves them; player props carry the tier A bets.

props.A: 5%+ EV (ours and blended) on an UNDER, or on receptions either side
props.B: 5%+ EV on an over of another stat (opener 53.5% / +1.9%, close 43% / -16%): lean, tracked
props.C: pass attempts, rushing yards and carries (lost at 5%+ EV at open and close)

tested.caveat: two weeks of games (Oct 16-26 2026), bets share games

reasons: Kickoff in 0.9 days: game-week line, so the blend counts 14% of our gap (best fit of our model plus the line on 2018-26 results); our NFL spread gaps have not held up at the close (2018-26)
The desk model is on the same side of the line
NFL spreads are a lean at most: the 2026 openers covered 49-56% (27-35 games) and the backtest knew the starting QB, which an opener often does not
Key numbers: Model A puts 14% on a 3-point margin and 9% on 7

u.why: NFL spread gaps have not held up at the close (2018-26)

reasons: Chance = the line plus 8% of our gap (best fit on 2018-26 results)
Measured against this slate: Model A sits +1.2 pts vs the market's totals on the median game, so only the part beyond that counts
NFL total gaps have lost: 2026 openers 3+ hit 39-44%, 2026 closes 43-48%. Shown for the number only, never a bet

u.why: NFL total gaps at 2026 closes hit 43-48%

reasons: Moneyline prices the spread's trusted edge as a win chance (key-number margin curve); a lean at most, only near pick'em. Win chance = the books' no-vig moneyline moved only by that trusted edge

u.why: Moneyline chance converted from the spread with a normal curve, never tested in any sport; that conversion makes big underdogs look +EV on its own, so ML ratings are capped at 60 and never a small play
